groups.name: Sri Lanka
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Dambulla, Kandy, Nuwaraeliya, Kataragama, Mirissa, Waskaduwa, Yale, Bentota, Colombo

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Dambulla, Kandy, Nuwaraeliya, Kataragama, Mirissa, Waskaduwa, Colombo at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the South Asia journeys we shape by hand through South Asia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Discover the golden Cave Temple, where ancient murals and serene Buddha statues fill five sacred chambers.
Experience Sri Lanka's cultural heart through the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, misty hills and graceful Kandyan traditions.
Wander through cool tea-clad highlands, colonial charm and misty landscapes reminiscent of "Little England".
Visit a deeply revered pilgrimage town where Buddhist, Hindu and indigenous traditions meet in spiritual harmony.
Relax beside palm-fringed beaches and enjoy unforgettable Indian Ocean sunsets, with whale-watching adventures offshore.
Unwind along a peaceful west-coast shoreline, where golden sands and ocean sunsets create a serene tropical escape.
Explore Sri Lanka's cosmopolitan gateway through Galle Face Green, Gangaramaya Temple, colonial quarters and lively markets.

groups.name: Nepal
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Birgunj, Chitwan, Pokhara, Kathmandu, Ghandruk

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Birgunj, Chitwan, Pokhara, Kathmandu, Ghandruk at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the South Asia journeys we shape by hand through South Asia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Enter Nepal through the lively "Gateway of Nepal," where border-town energy meets temples, markets and local colour.
Track rhinos and Bengal tigers on jungle safaris through one of Nepal's richest wildlife sanctuaries.
Drift beside Phewa Lake under the Annapurna skyline, with waterfalls, caves and serene Himalayan reflections.
Explore a valley of living heritage, where ancient stupas, royal squares and sacred temples shape every corner.

groups.name: Bhutan
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, Phunotsiling

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Thimphu, Punakha, Paro at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the South Asia journeys we shape by hand through South Asia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Discover Bhutanese culture through Tashichhoe Dzong, the Memorial Chorten and the serene Buddha Dordenma overlooking the valley.
Admire the magnificent Punakha Dzong, beautifully set at the meeting point of the Pho Chhu and Mo Chhu rivers.
Hike through pine forests to the legendary cliffside Tiger's Nest Monastery, with breathtaking views across the Paro Valley.

groups.name: Maldives
groups.tagline: 4 Nights, 5 Days · Male’, Addu City, Maafushi, Naifaru, Hithadoo

offer.summary: 5 days trip built around Male', Addu City, Maafushi, Naifaru, Hithadoo at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the South Asia journeys we shape by hand through South Asia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Explore the compact capital through the Grand Friday Mosque, colourful markets, the National Museum and lively waterfront streets.
Discover the Maldives' southernmost atoll through tropical lagoons, wartime heritage, local villages and rich marine life.
Enjoy turquoise waters, vibrant reef life, island excursions and relaxed moments on its welcoming Bikini Beach.
Experience authentic island life through peaceful beaches, local traditions, fishing culture and surrounding lagoon adventures.
Unwind among mangroves, freshwater lakes, quiet beaches and the preserved history of Addu's largest island.
